description: Agent ticket queue — file, view, answer, triage, and resolve tickets on any agent in the Command Center. A ticket is client feedback / critique / an idea / a feature request / a bug. Every ticket lives on an agent (agent_slug is always required) and auto-assigns to the Ernie triage agent. Use action=create to file one, action=comment to answer a thread, action=update or action=resolve to triage. Backed by /admin/agents/{slug}/tickets; admin API key required.

action.description: Action: list (every ticket on an agent + stats), get (one ticket + its comment thread), create (file a new ticket), comment (add a reply to a ticket's thread — this is how you answer a ticket), update (triage — change status/priority/kind/assignee), resolve (shortcut: mark the ticket resolved), delete (remove the ticket, its comments, and its mirrored Life task)

agent_slug.description: Slug of the agent the ticket belongs to. REQUIRED for every action.

assignee.description: Reassign the ticket (action=update) to an agent slug or a username. Tickets default to the 'ernie' triage agent.

body.description: Ticket body when action=create, or the comment text when action=comment.

kind.description: Ticket kind (create or update). Defaults to 'feedback' on create.

priority.description: Ticket priority (create or update). Defaults to 'medium' on create.

status.description: New status for action=update, or a status filter for action=list.

name: mind_tickets
